newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sept 1st 20 days trade surplus down 43.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sept 1st 20 days trade surplus down 43.3 pct.

text.p: Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus for the first 20 days of September was 274.99 billion yen, down 43.3 percent from a revised surplus of 484.95 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry announced on Monday.
The figure compared with a trade surplus of 69.09 billion yen in the first 20 days of August.
Free on board (FOB) exports rose 11.0 percent to 2.48 trillion yen from a year earlier, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 26.0 percent to 2.20 trillion yen.
